svg.title: How requests settle
svg.desc: Investors contribute to a bucket, which goes to the hub as one order. Buckets are rows and investors are columns: each cell is a contribution, folded into that investor's ledger when someone asks. A claim folds only the latest rows of an investor, their horizon; a settlement folds an unbatched row, and foldRequest folds any row.
svg.text: Requests pool into a bucket, which goes to the hub as one order
Buckets are rows, contributions are cells, a horizon is an investor's latest rows
Cells are assets, the ledger is shares. A fold credits a cell to its investor's ledger: slice = fill x contribution / total, then / 2.0 price
